machine.description: Apple M6, 32 GiB unified memory, macOS 27.0
machine.note: every local system ran on this one machine

plamo.description: Source text alone as the user message; the GGUF's embedded chat template receives the lower-case source and target language codes as template arguments.

generic-instruction.description: English instruction naming both languages, then the source; the embedded chat template formats it.
generic-instruction.message:
Translate from {source} into {target}. Return only the translation.

{text}

index-translate.description: Chinese instruction naming both languages in Chinese.
index-translate.message:
请将以下{source_zh}文本翻译为{target_zh}，直接输出翻译结果，不要进行任何解释。

{text}

hy-mt.description: Chinese instruction when either language is Simplified Chinese, otherwise English.
hy-mt.message_chinese:
将以下文本翻译为{target_zh}，注意只需要输出翻译后的结果，不要额外解释：

{text}
hy-mt.message:
Translate the following text into {target}. Note that you should only output the translated result without any additional explanation:

{text}

translategemma.description: The published TranslateGemma text format rendered as a raw prompt; the server prepends the GGUF's BOS token. Chinese is named 'Chinese' with code zh-Hans.
translategemma.prompt:
<start_of_turn>user
You are a professional {source} ({source_code}) to {target} ({target_code}) translator. Your goal is to accurately convey the meaning and nuances of the original {source} text while adhering to {target} grammar, vocabulary, and cultural sensitivities.
Produce only the {target} translation, without any additional explanations or commentary. Please translate the following {source} text into {target}:


{text_stripped}<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model

seed-x.description: Seed-X prompt with the target tag, sent as token IDs from the base model's tokenizer.json (the GGUF's embedded tokenizer gives a different sequence). Chinese is named 'Chinese' with tag zh; Brazilian Portuguese uses tag pt.

qwen-mt-lumen.description: Qwen-MT-Lumen's minimal prompt with an empty guidelines block, through the model's chat template in MLX.
qwen-mt-lumen.message:
Please translate the following text into {target}.
#guidelines
#src_text
{text}

apple-foundation-models.description: The generic instruction sent to a fresh LanguageModelSession for each item, with no session instructions, through a Swift helper that stays loaded across items.
apple-foundation-models.message:
Translate from {source} into {target}. Return only the translation.

{text}

apple-translation.description: The plain source, line breaks included, to TranslationSession(installedSource:target:preferredStrategy:) with explicit languages and the highFidelity strategy; one session per direction.

cloud-batch-json.description: One request carries up to 25 sentences or up to 5 passages of one direction as a JSON object; the model returns one JSON object with every key. {language} is the target language name.
cloud-batch-json.message:
Translate each item independently into {language}. Preserve the source's meaning, facts, names, quantities, register, and paragraph breaks. Use only the supplied text. Do not use tools, files, web search, or citations. Return one JSON object mapping every supplied key to its translation string in the same order. Use JSON escapes for line breaks inside strings. Return only the object.

{json_payload}
cloud-batch-json.payload: json.dumps({'T01': source, 'T02': source, ...}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), in frozen input order

deepl-text.description: Source strings only, as a text array, with explicit source and target languages. English output is EN-US, Portuguese PT-BR, Chinese ZH-HANS and Arabic AR.
